placements.title: ownership shifts the asset from substrate to perspective
placements.frame: Does the expression treat the underlying substrate as a fungible commodity while treating owned perspective as the asset that is retained and compounds?
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 jointly state a thesis future envelopes will keep feeding — that owned intelligence differs from rented intelligence because the substrate is commodity while the perspective is the retained asset. This is subject-grain (a thesis about where value sits), not a one-time fact, so it passes the narrative grain test. No existing strata or narrative leaf structure was supplied (both are empty for this repo), and the perspective's map/index and the focused witness-depth expansion confirmed no existing coverage of owned/rented intelligence or substrate-as-commodity framing, so nothing exists to reuse — this is a genuine NEW mint, standalone with no parent since no hub or strata category yet holds this theme.
